title: I Tried Autodesk's New AI 3D Tool – And It's Insanely Easy
description:
AutodeskPartner This is autodeskflowstudio a cloudbased AIpowered 3D toolset that turns your footage even simple videos from your phone into editable CG scenes It also features new Imageto3D and Textto3D tools so you can turn any image or prompt into a 3D character creature or prop and then automatically texturize it Its so easy that a guy like me with no real 3D experience can apply a CGI character to any actor in just a few clicks
Roberto Nickson
